I cannot recommend Kahoots more highly and in particular Debi, the manager who has been there for 12+ years.  She LOVES her job and LOVES helping people find exactly what and all they need for their beloved pets.

With so many brick and mortar stores closing, Kahoots is expanding, I can see why.  I went in to purchase only one item but when I told Debi that my kitty only ate fish and I wanted him to have a more varied diet which includes meat to avoid so much mercury as well as the toxins from the Japanese nuclear break down still found in abundance in fish, she was and has been absolutely wonderful.  She makes me feel as if she has all the time in the world for me.  She is as eager to find non-fish whole foods for my kitty as I am and, she is always enthusiastic about doing so.

She also guides me on how to introduce these new foods/meats to my kitty.  I am grateful and delighted to report we are achieving success in expanding his diet beyond fish without much inconvenience.

I also love that if my kitty does not like a food, I can return it with the receipt and as long as it is within a month.  I returned only one item, the most expensive.  Debi was gracious and joyful as she took my return.  And, on top of that helped recommend three other non-fish whole foods for my kitty which I purchased.

I brought them home yesterday and to my surprise he is already eating two of the three!!

I am discovering foods, I did not even know existed for my kitty!  All healthy, no toxins, and all whole.

I never planned on spending as much as I have with Kahoots but I also never planned on having so much practical support for my kitten’s needs and health.  I did not plan on such convenience, Kahoots is only 15 minutes from where I live.  It is so much easier, even more economical, are trustworthy and satisfying to work with Debi at Kahoots then online.   And, I am buying right for my kitty because I am collaborating with Debi.

Thank you so much Debi!

This is a second review written because I remain impressed with and grateful for how exceptionally generous Debi is in her helpfulness in finding healthy foods my kitty loves.  And, she is does so with quiet joyfulness which is so rare these days.

I am also writing a second review to inform pet lovers that Kahoots sells fresh frozen whole quail eggs which my kitty cat loves.  My neighbor’s dog also loves his quail egg treats which I toss to him and which he gobbles up and, of course asks for more when he comes over to visit.

And quail eggs as a treat is healthy which is important to me.  I love my little furry friend so much I want him to live as long and be as healthy as possible so he enjoys living.  Therefore, I feed him only the healthiest foods.

Debi is a gift towards the care and well being of my kitty and aids me wonderfully in giving my kitty only the cleanest, healthiest, non-toxic foods.

2 star reviews are rare for us since we are always looking for opportunities in which we can improve. Please feel free to contact us directly at customerservice@kahoots.bz if you'd like to share more info. ⭐🐶⭐ …

Kahoots is the only local place that sells Farmina N&D wet cat food. This is the only canned wet food my cat will eat. She's a very picky cat!
UPDATE: Unfortunately, I had a negative experience at the Chatsworth location. Since Kahoots is the only store, that I know of, that sells Farmina locally, my last purchase consisted of 20 cans that I cleaned off of their shelf. I had a few cans left at home from a previous purchase there and I wanted to stock up. Well, then my picky cat decided she didn't want to eat it anymore. I tried to feed her again a few days later. Since she refused to continue eating the Farmina, I decided to return all 20 cans. I had my receipt and I wanted store credit. I did not want a refund so they were not going to lose the sale. The first time I went in, the on duty manager would not take back the entire sale. She said the SKU scan code was not in their computer. I told her I got all 20 cans from the cat food shelf I pointed to. The can labels were very similiar and apparently there were two different flavors that had different SKU codes. I remembered that the original salesperson did have trouble scanning some of those cans when I purchased them but what I see now what was done was that he used the same SKU for all the cans. Even after explaining this to the assistant manager, and having the receipt, she only offered a partial refund. She said that I could come back the next day and speak with the store manager. I left there feeling like that visit was useless and they were unwilling to help me. I went back the next day and a man helped me at the counter and promptly issued me store credit for all 20 cans. I explained what happened because he also saw that the SKU was incorrect for half of the cans and he said the original salesperson just pushed it though with the other SKU. I finally got my store credit and went shopping. I noticed, who I think was the store manager, approach the man at the counter to speak with him. He didn't look happy. I didn't want anyone to get into trouble. I am not using names here. At check out, my total was $83.18 so I used the store credit for $54.98 and gladly paid the difference of $28.20. During check out, he said to me that some of the cans were not bought here. I guess the manager had words with him about doing the refund. I insisted again that I did buy them here. I had the receipt and I know where I bought them. If I had bought them somewhere else then I would have returned them there! I bought them at that Kahoots location. The only other stores I shop at are PetSmart and Petco but those stores clearly do not carry Farmina N&D. I bought 20 cans at Kahoots, had the receipt, and they got the 20 cans back. The manager never said a word to me. I left there feeling angry. Basically the entire staff I dealt with was short of actually calling me a liar and thought I was trying to pull a fast one on them. They never lost any money here and they can resell the returned cans since nothing was wrong with them. It's not my fault the correct SKU was not entered into their computer system. The sale was made. I had asked the original salesperson about other flavors for that brand and he said they get in whatever is sent to them. Since the labels are similiar, maybe the other flavor was not entered into the system because someone thought it was the same flavor as the others. Of course this would throw inventory off and I realize it's important that it all matches but that's not my fault. Maybe the item was discontinued at their store? I have worked numerous retail sales jobs in my life and I have been a store manager at many of them so I know how it works. A packing slip may show that item but then it was not correctly put into inventory. Mistakes happen. I did get the refund but after leaving the store twice for this, I felt like the staff was glaring at me, pratically accusing me of lying and being some sort of scam artist. I will not be returning to Kahoots. I am upset and hurt because I did like the store and wanted to continue being a loyal customer.
